data.credibility: Management shows mixed credibility, frequently reiterating long-term targets for FMEG and margins but quietly dropping specific multi-year capex and dividend payout plans. Working capital normalized well ahead of guided days.

lines.line: Working capital cycle target of 50 to 55 days was surpassed, actual reached 11 days.
Export contribution target of greater than 10% by FY2030 remains on track.
FMEG EBITDA margin target of 8% to 10% by FY2030 remains on track at 10.1%.
EHV plant commissioning target by end of next calendar year was marked delayed.
Project Spring annual capex guidance of 12 billion to 16 billion rupees was dropped.
BharatNet orders expected to generate 4.5 billion rupees over 3 years remain on track.
BharatNet project O&M expected to generate 3.5 billion rupees over 10 years was dropped.
Dividend payout ratio target of 30% by financial year 2030 was dropped.
Planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over 5 years was dropped.
Wires and Cables margin guidance of 11% to 13% is on track at 14.1%.
FMEG business growth expectation of 1.5x to 2x industry growth is on track.
EPC sustainable operating margins expected in high single digits are on track at 14.1%.

overrides.reason: Actual operating margin for EPC reached 14.1%, outperforming the high single digit guidance range of 7% to 9%.

bull: Revenue compounded 26.9% a year over five years, supported by a large network of over 190,000 retail touchpoints.
Operating cash flow reached 101% of reported profit over 5 years, with working-capital days tightening from 67 to 30.
The balance sheet is nearly debt-free with borrowings of ₹272 cr against a net worth of ₹13,094 cr.
bear: Management has dropped multiple multi-year commitments including the ₹60 billion to ₹80 billion capex program and 30% dividend payout target.
Valuation stands elevated with a P/E of 36.2 against trailing net profit of ₹3,202 cr.
Export contribution is targeted at greater than 10% by FY2030 while project execution timelines like the EHV plant face delays.
